method: Whole-file manual reading of five state/model files; exact-commit downloads matched pinned Git blob IDs.
findings: WindowRecord persists mutable native Handle using IntPtrConverter and CreatedAt from Environment.TickCount. Handle can be recycled and TickCount is boot-relative signed32-bit before promotion to long; persisted values alone cannot establish cross-session identity or absolute chronology. Caller restoration validation not yet reviewed.

WindowInfo uses Stopwatch timestamp for creation and stores COM event delegates with mutable location/name. Its timestamp differs in scale/origin from WindowRecord CreatedAt; no interchangeability implied.

DisplayLocation globally replaces literal file scheme/backslash prefix then URI-unescapes for display. It is not general canonicalization or an identity key; encoded separators may become display characters without representing original path bytes.

HotKeyProfile Clone preserves Guid Id and copies HotKeys array, isolating array mutation but retaining same logical profile identity. Other fields are mutable; no Delay range or enum/key validation within model.
HotKeyEventArgs stores original profile reference rather than snapshot. Deferred consumers can observe subsequent edits unless callers clone. No actual race reproduced.
WindowRecord selected items array is stored directly without defensive copying. Supporter URLs are unvalidated model strings; use-site navigation/image loading not yet reviewed.
limits: No Windows handle-reuse, persistence roundtrip, COM lifecycle or original tests executed in this increment. No foreign production code adopted.
